title: Chain Compound of Mixed-Valent Ruthenium Dimers Linked by Hydrogen-Bonding between the Axially Coordinated Nitronyl Nitroxide and Water Molecules
abstract: Abstract                An adduct of ruthenium(II,III) dimer with nitronyl nitroxide, [{Ru2(O2CCMe3)4(nitme)2}{Ru2(O2CCMe3)4(H2O)2}]n(BF4)2n (nitme = 2,4,4,5,5-pentamethyl-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazolyl-1-oxyl 3-oxide), which has a chain structure formed by hydrogen bonds between the axial nitme and water molecules, has been prepared and characterized by the X-ray crystallography, magnetic susceptibility, and EPR measurements.
